review.notes: Automated word-level diff of extracted text from all 22 physical PDF pages against the normalized OCR markdown (order-insensitive whole-document matching), a fence check (no code fences), a heading audit, and a whole-reference URL comparison (every OCR URL canonically matched against the PDF text, with wrapped URLs rejoined). Teaser/axis labels on p.1 and p.15, the probability-axis labels on p.8 and the J_REINFORCE/J_PPO/J_unify subscripted objectives on p.5-7 are math- or figure-internal and not defects. Real defects: dropped title-page footnote 1 and copyright footer, dropped footnote 2 (TAU-bench system prompt), and three misread openreview IDs in the references. All repairs verified on 300-400 dpi renders of physical pages 1, 14, 16, 17 and 19.
